name: Royal Hill of Ambohimanga
description: Ambohimanga is a fortified royal hilltop village about 24 kilometres northeast of Antananarivo, Madagascar. Stone walls and defensive ditches surround the compound, which is entered through 14 gateways and holds the residences and tombs of Merina kings. Considered the kingdom's spiritual capital, it remains a sacred place where pilgrims still come to worship.
